claims.statement: For the order-91 T_22 control, attaching one new pendant leaf at root 0 yields an order-92 tree in which the original marked leaf has a negative selected summand at every eligible rank and the complete favorable-leaf sum is strictly negative at every eligible rank.
claims.scope: The exact T_22 recipe in the source case with one new leaf 91 attached to root 0; all integer ranks p=35,...,45 with x=33, alpha=68, and 3p<2alpha+1. No other padding length, attachment vertex, or source tree.
claims.reason: retained — the graph is an ordinary tree, the exact polynomial recurrence and guards check, and a replay from a scratch copy of the pinned evaluator matches the coefficient vector, full selector set, all original-support summands, and full sum at every eligible rank.

limitations: This verifies only T_22 with a single new leaf attached at its root; it establishes no family-level padding result.
The finite computation does not prove or refute the universal lower-region favorable-leaf aggregate.
